notes: Natixis GIFT City IBU. No public deposit rate page found.

gap_classification.notes: Natixis CIB opened its GIFT City IBU branch on 2026-05-01. It offers foreign-currency-denominated structured products and finance (energy & commodities, infrastructure, aviation, export financing, ECB) to corporate and institutional clients only. No deposit product and no published rate table. Wholesale-only IBU.
